I use various tools and methods to make this process easier for you: role plays, video material, newspaper articles, homework, all of this in a fun and challenging way.

teacher_info.teaching_style: My lessons are aimed at adults and students aged 15 and above and are characterised by an informal style, allowing the student to speak in the target language as much as possible. I put students at ease, encourage them and I try to listen as patiently as possible. I pay attention to the pronunciation, grammar, sentence structure and vocabulary used by the student and I correct immediately where necessary. In a separate document, I keep track of the topic and vocabulary and do not miss the opportunity to explain a grammatical problem directly. I use textbooks, magazines, separate documents, stories, illustrations, newspaper articles and video files to teach everyday Dutch.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Practice. B1-C2 (Let's work on increasing your language level)
pro_course_detail.description:
B1-B2
This lesson focuses on general conversations that will improve the student's spoken English. 
The lesson caters to students with an intermediate level of spoken English. The interests of the student will also be incorporated into the lesson to make it a fun and relatable learning experience. 
These lessons will include more corrections in terms of pronunciation vocabulary, and parts of speech(nouns, pronouns, adjectives, determiners, verbs, adverbs, prepositions, conjunctions, and interjections), all of which make up the grammar when speaking English.
The lesson will focus on key factors that make up the English language, those factors include Grammar, Vocabulary, and Pronunciation. Students can expect valuable feedback on each of these factors.

B2-C2
This lesson focuses on conversational practices that will further improve the student's spoken English. 
The lesson caters to students with an advanced to a proficient level of spoken English. The interests of the student will also be incorporated into the lesson to make it a fun and relatable learning experience. 
These lessons will focus more on advanced communication and the complex use of vocabulary. Students can expect intense corrections on the simplest habitual mistakes such as the use of incorrect suffixes and prefixes, incorrect tenses, and other grammar-related mistakes.
The lesson will focus on key factors that make up the English language, those include Grammar, Vocabulary, and Pronunciation. Students can expect valuable feedback on each of these factors.

pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation
pro_course_detail.description:
The purpose of this lesson is to prepare Non-Native English speakers for a Job Interview or Promotion. 

During this lesson, we will go through various common Interview questions and focus on responding to them effectively. The lesson focuses on more than just grammar and language, tone of voice, length of answers, and how to answer trick questions are among the few interview strategies that will be practised during this lesson.

Your specific Job Application or Promotion will be the main focus of the lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: CONꓦERSATIONAL PORTUGUESE CLASS ( SINGLE LESSON)
pro_course_detail.description:
BEM-VINDO À "Aula de Conversação em Português (Lições Individuais)"! Nesta sessão envolvente e interativa, você pode esperar aprimorar suas habilidades na língua portuguesa por meio de exercícios práticos e cenários de conversação do dia a dia.

Objetivo: O objetivo principal desta aula é melhorar suas habilidades de conversação em português. Se você é iniciante e busca construir confiança ao falar ou se é um aluno intermediário/avançado procurando refinar sua proficiência na língua, esta aula é adequada para todos os níveis.

ESTRUTURA DA AULA:

Quebra-gelo: A aula começará com uma atividade descontraída para quebrar o gelo. Isso ajudará você a se sentir confortável, criando um ambiente relaxado para um aprendizado eficaz.

Enriquecimento de Vocabulário: Você será apresentado a novo vocabulário relacionado a vários temas, como viagens, comida, hobbies ou eventos atuais. O instrutor fornecerá explicações e exemplos, e você terá a oportunidade de praticar o uso das palavras em contexto.

Essa abordagem permite que você pratique situações da vida real, como fazer um pedido em um restaurante, pedir direções ou fazer pequenas conversas com estranhos. O instrutor irá orientá-lo e fornecer feedback construtivo para melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.

Correção de Erros: Cometer erros é uma parte natural do aprendizado, e esta aula é um espaço seguro para cometê-los. O instrutor fornecerá correções suaves e dicas para ajudá-lo a evitar erros comuns e reforçar o uso correto da língua.

Conhecimentos Culturais: A língua e a cultura caminham juntas. Você obterá insights sobre culturas, costumes e normas sociais de países de língua portuguesa. Esse conhecimento o ajudará a compreender o contexto por trás de certas expressões e a aprimorar sua proficiência geral na língua.

pro_course_detail.title: CONꓦERSATIONAL ENGLISH CLASS ( SINGLE LESSON)
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to the "Conversational English Class (Single Lesson)"! In this engaging and interactive session, you can expect to improve your English language skills through practical exercises and real-life conversation scenarios.

Objective: The primary objective of this class is to enhance your conversational skills in English. Whether you are a beginner looking to build confidence in speaking or an intermediate/advanced learner seeking to refine your language proficiency, this class caters to all levels.

CLASS STRUCTURE:
Icebreaker: The class will kick off with a friendly icebreaker activity. This will help you feel comfortable, creating a relaxed environment for effective learning.

Vocabulary Enhancement: You will be introduced to new vocabulary related to various topics such as travel, food, hobbies, or current events. The instructor will provide explanations and examples, and you will get a chance to practice using the words in context.

Role-Playing: Through role-playing exercises, you will participate in simulated conversations. This approach allows you to practice real-life scenarios, such as ordering food at a restaurant, asking for directions, or making small talk with strangers. The instructor will guide you and provide constructive feedback to improve your language skills.

Error Correction: Mistakes are a natural part of learning, and this class is a safe space to make them. The instructor will provide gentle corrections and tips to help you avoid common errors and reinforce proper language usage.

Cultural Insights: Cultural Insights: Language and culture go hand in hand. You will gain insights into English-speaking cultures, customs, and social norms. This knowledge will aid you in understanding the context behind certain expressions and enhance your overall language proficiency.              

BENEFITS: 
Improved fluency: Regular practice in conversational settings will boost your confidence and fluency in English.

BEM-VINDO À "Aula de Conversação em Português (Lições Individuais)"! Nesta sessão envolvente e interativa, você pode esperar aprimorar suas habilidades na língua portuguesa por meio de exercícios práticos e cenários de conversação do dia a dia.

Objetivo: O objetivo principal desta aula é melhorar suas habilidades de conversação em português. Se você é iniciante e busca construir confiança ao falar ou se é um aluno intermediário/avançado procurando refinar sua proficiência na língua, esta aula é adequada para todos os níveis.

ESTRUTURA DA AULA:

Quebra-gelo: A aula começará com uma atividade descontraída para quebrar o gelo. Isso ajudará você a se sentir confortável, criando um ambiente relaxado para um aprendizado eficaz.

Enriquecimento de Vocabulário: Você será apresentado a novo vocabulário relacionado a vários temas, como viagens, comida, hobbies ou eventos atuais. O instrutor fornecerá explicações e exemplos, e você terá a oportunidade de praticar o uso das palavras em contexto.

Essa abordagem permite que você pratique situações da vida real, como fazer um pedido em um restaurante, pedir direções ou fazer pequenas conversas com estranhos. O instrutor irá orientá-lo e fornecer feedback construtivo para melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas.

Correção de Erros: Cometer erros é uma parte natural do aprendizado, e esta aula é um espaço seguro para cometê-los. O instrutor fornecerá correções suaves e dicas para ajudá-lo a evitar erros comuns e reforçar o uso correto da língua.

Conhecimentos Culturais: A língua e a cultura caminham juntas. Você obterá insights sobre culturas, costumes e normas sociais de países de língua portuguesa. Esse conhecimento o ajudará a compreender o contexto por trás de certas expressões e a aprimorar sua proficiência geral na língua.

course_info.trial_description:
The trial lesson is an opportunity for us to discuss your language learning objectives and assess your current proficiency level. During this session, I will introduce you to my teaching methodology and explain how lessons are tailored to suit your individual needs and goals.

We will conduct a comprehensive assessment to identify your strengths and areas for development. I will also outline how our future lessons will be structured, ensuring they are aligned with your specific objectives. You will gain insight into the tools and strategies I use to facilitate progress and achieve consistent improvement.

This session also provides an opportunity for you to ask questions, clarify expectations, and determine if my teaching approach is the right fit for you, setting a solid foundation for our future lessons.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Speaking
pro_course_detail.description:
In my IELTS Speaking classes, I’ll help you develop the skills and confidence necessary to excel in the exam and achieve your target score. We’ll work through authentic exam questions across all three parts, focusing on how to deliver well-structured, detailed responses, avoid common pitfalls, and naturally incorporate a range of vocabulary and grammar.

I’ll guide you on enhancing fluency, coherence, and response length, ensuring your answers are both articulate and confident. Each session is customized to your level and objectives, whether you're aiming for 6.5+ or need to improve from a 5.5. Through targeted practice and detailed feedback, you’ll gain clear strategies to elevate your performance.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
In my IELTS Writing classes, I’ll guide you in refining your writing skills to achieve a higher score on both Task 1 and Task 2. We will focus on crafting clear, concise, and well-organized essays, emphasizing effective question analysis, paragraph structure, and providing relevant examples to support your arguments.

I’ll help you develop strategies to improve task response, coherence, cohesion, lexical resource, and grammatical accuracy. Each lesson is tailored to your level and specific goals, whether you aim to elevate your score to Band 6.5 or progress further. You will receive comprehensive feedback and targeted guidance to enhance your writing style and overall performance.

pro_course_detail.title: Academic English
pro_course_detail.description:
In my Academic English classes, I focus on developing the key skills needed for success in university-level writing and communication. We will work on enhancing your academic writing, including essay structure, critical analysis, and the use of formal academic language. Special attention will be given to improving your ability to write clear, coherent arguments, conduct literature reviews, and cite sources correctly.

I’ll also help you master the nuances of academic vocabulary and grammar, ensuring you can express ideas precisely and effectively. Each lesson is personalized to address your specific academic goals, whether you’re preparing for university assignments or looking to improve your overall academic writing. You’ll receive constructive feedback and practical strategies to advance your writing proficiency and academic performance.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English
pro_course_detail.description:
In my Business English classes, I focus on developing the language skills essential for effective communication in the professional world. Whether you're preparing for business meetings, crafting formal reports, or delivering presentations, I’ll help you communicate with precision and professionalism.

We will focus on key areas such as advanced business vocabulary, formal writing conventions, negotiation strategies, and effective verbal communication. Each lesson is tailored to your specific needs and professional context, whether you're looking to enhance your job interview performance, improve business correspondence, or refine your overall communication skills.

Through targeted feedback and structured practice, you’ll gain the confidence and fluency needed to succeed in a global business environment.

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description:
In my General English lessons, I focus on helping you develop your language skills for everyday communication. Whether you're looking to improve your speaking, listening, reading, or writing, I tailor each lesson to meet your individual needs and goals.

What to Expect:

Speaking and Listening: Practice real-world conversations, enhance your fluency, and improve your listening comprehension.

Reading and Writing: Strengthen your reading skills with diverse texts and improve your writing for various purposes.

Vocabulary and Grammar: Learn new vocabulary and refine your grammar through practical exercises and explanations.

Pronunciation: Work on clear and effective pronunciation to boost your confidence and clarity.
Each lesson is interactive, engaging, and designed to help you achieve steady progress. 

Whether you're a beginner or looking to refine your skills, my General English lessons will support your journey to becoming a more confident English speaker.
